message: Here's the 2021 Rav4 GX Hybrid 2WD on 58,400 km. The floor car is a 2020 GX Hybrid 2WD on only 31,610 km, at $36,090: https://www.carsales.com.au/cars/details/2020-toyota-rav4-gx-auto-efour/OAG-AD-26459339/. The next cars up are $36,850. Allowing for the extra km on yours, I'd be around $28-29k. To be on the cautious side without seeing photos, probably around $27-28k. By plate year: '20 plates from $36,090 (2 comps); '21 plates: none in our data. Only 1 2021 car (need 2), so the floor is the cheapest 2020 car (one plate year below), not a 2021 price. Only 2 comparable dealer cars in Carbitrage, so the evidence is thin; treat this as rough. Rough range $32,500-$36,850. You pick your number.

search_window.years_rule: 2020 and any newer year, same shape

method: Our own market data: live dealer asks from dealer sites and Carsales (last 21 days), private sellers, auctions and unlabelled Gumtree left out. Same make/model and badge (engine checked where the ad shows it), plate year minus one and any newer year (same shape only), 0 to km+15,000, 2WD and AWD not split (each comp is labelled), cheapest credible dealer car = floor, ex-government charges. A retail asking price, not a buy price. You pick your number.
